query_model.description: Run inference on a model served by Hugging Face's serverless Inference API. Give the model's repository id and the text to send; the action returns the model's output. Works across tasks such as summarization, classification, translation, and feature extraction (embeddings).

mock_response.generated_text: Hugging Face builds tools for machine learning and hosts open models.

result.summary_text: Hugging Face builds tools for machine learning and hosts open models.

query_model.name: query_model

parameters.description: The Hugging Face model repository id to run, e.g. 'facebook/bart-large-cnn'. The model must be served by the hf-inference provider (Hugging Face's serverless inference) - its model page shows an 'HF Inference' provider when it is.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: The text to send to the model - a prompt to continue, a passage to summarize or translate, a sentence to classify, and so on.
parameters.name: inputs

parameters.description: Optional task-specific parameters passed straight to the model, e.g. {"max_length": 130, "min_length": 30} for summarization. Leave empty for the model's defaults.
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.description: Serverless models are loaded on demand. When enabled, the request waits for a cold model to finish loading instead of failing; disable to return immediately.
parameters.name: wait_for_model

query_model.result_str_template: Received a response from the model.

generated_text.description: The model's primary text output, for text-producing tasks (summarization, translation, generation). Null for tasks that don't produce text (see 'result').

model.description: The model repository id that was queried.

result.description: The raw model output. Its shape depends on the model's task: a list of summaries for summarization, nested label/score lists for classification, and so on.

description: Run inference on open models hosted on the Hugging Face Inference API.
